prompt.alinti: A frontier AI model showed up out of nowhere and nobody will say who built it.
Ox Alpha appeared on OpenRouter on 20 August. 1M context, text image and video input, $0 per million tokens, and no lab attached to it.
Researcher Ben Davis puts it at 99% certainty this is Z.ai’s unreleased GLM-5.x. No lab has confirmed it.
One catch. The 80% DeepSWE score everyone quoted came from 10 tasks. The full run says 63%.
